pages.text: The $(d)Mob Sight$() Gene occasionally $(9)gives all nearby mobs the Glowing effect$().$(br2)Both the cooldown and radius are configurable, defaulting to 1 second and 32 blocks respectively.$(br2)This gene $(c)cannot be given to mobs$().
These are the default chances. Modpacks may change them.$(br2)3/8 - Bat$(br)3/7 - Elder Guardian$(br)3/12 - Guardian$(br)5/10 - Warden
pages.title: Default Weights
